task_title: Floor 4 slice 3 — deterministic waves, manifests, gates, cap, debt, cut

plan_review.notes: Adversarial red-team of the slice-3 plan. 4 alternatives enumerated and argued against (separate floor4WaveSystem; one RNG stream per act; suppressed-death-event cut; keep end-to-end headless victory now). All 10 concerns folded into the design before coding: (1) wave-0 telegraph clamped to arena t=0 and documented; (2) director rewritten as a bounded chronological boundary loop so a single large delta emits every crossed telegraph/release exactly once (equivalence test vs fixed steps); (3) cap defined over live hostile arena combatants (Enemy, hp>0, no DeathTimer, non-player team) so future summons share it; (4) wave ownership carried by a real ECS marker component, not an EID set, so recycled EIDs cannot be cut; (5) threat costs and budgets are validated positive integers with an explicit termination invariant; (6) the cut skips already-dead/DeathTimer entities so it can never race dropSystem; (7) gate spawn slots are enumerated and walkability-validated at scenario init, failing loudly, with zero runtime retry/RNG; (8) telegraph/cut counts recorded in floor state + RunStats first, VFX purely presentational; (9) manifest waves block cross-validates enemyPackId and every roster archetype id against the enemy-pack registry at load; (10) idle-provider headless victory test retired explicitly as a documented slice-3 deviation and replaced with bounded real-pipeline act-1 wave telemetry coverage.
